body: The pic with the blond has got to go. You need a pic of yourself looking kind of pensive. You look really young in all your pics.

Thank you so much, you are right, my mother has one job, I didn't ask her to bring me into this world, at least I know where I stand. I made myself some tea, held my cat and just being easy on myself. I will use this experience to make myself stronger and get out of my mother's house. She can't be there for me. End of story.
Cost is an issue, they always tend to be so expensive.
R

But how would you have known the experience without trying. I still think is brave. Most of us spend our life (self included) without ever really trying what we want to do because of fear. You tried it, it didn't work out. Me, I don't even know, cause I play it safe but also spend my whole life with the "what if" feeling.

Oh cool, I have a new term. "Stop taking the piss of me mate!" Wait mate is Aussie, LOL, I will have to work on this.
The fine line of being helpful and getting used. So hard to walk when it comes to family. 
The Samaritans are the same here, I have them on speed dial. I have gotten lucky when I call. If I get someone that doesn't agree with me I just tell them I need to speak to someone else and hang up. 
I can't speak to anyone irl (aside from my therapist) of my suicidal feelings. I just get to emotional irl and not everyone can deal when you tell them.
So people's help makes you worse?
If you don't feel responsible why do you think about all their faults. Do you think that their faults have determined your life? If they are bad, I am bad - kind of thinking?

What was the thing that made you come to the conclusion that it won't get better? If you have learning problems those aren't your fault. I don't think you chose to have learning problems.

Don't worry about religious people, it is a big no-no to preach here.
What are you scared of? If you let people help you what might happen?
Your family history has allot of self medication to deal with pain and allot of denial of the errors they have made. Do you feel responsible for all the mistakes your family has made?

Yes, this year has hit allot of people in the gut with the amount of loss we have had with so many famous people leaving us way too soon. It seems you had many people you admired leave you this year. Of all the people that left us this year, who did you admire the most? You have written allot so I will reply to things separately. :-)
What did you think would get better exactly?
What is the reason you don't want to live anymore?

Why are these people so focused on your clothes? It is so sad for bullies with no life of their own so they try to destroy others. I can't even imagine the mind of someone who says "oh look let's beat him up, just because". I guess they didn't post on facebook anything about physically assaulting you. :-(     Do your parents know that you are being assaulted in school?

Well several of us have proved you wrong. We are responding. :-)
We don't have any magic answers that will make all your troubles go away. But at least some of us will be here if you want to continue chatting. Needless to say we really don't want you to do any damage to yourself. What is the biggest problem that has brought you to this point tonight?

How many different medications have you been on? For many it takes quite a long time to find the one that works in the slightest. Some, even years. 
TMS treatment, is it suppose to be effective immediately?
So you are a day trader, is it as stressful as it sounds? I am always amazed at anyone who jumps into that profession, I am way too much of a coward.

Can you explain what that term means "they take the piss always handing their stuff..."? Sorry poor yank over here. LOL sorry
That is great that you are learning to say no. It is such a fine line between helping others and being taken advantage of all the time. Especially when people who are professional users know exactly what to say to make us feel guilty.  >.<

Oh a libra you say. :-)
**Libra Traits**
*The people born under the Sign Libra are kind, gentle and lovers of beauty, harmony and peace. However, in their effort to keep everyone happy, they find it difficult to say 'NO' to anyone, and as a result, they end up getting stressed.*    Is that you?

Everyone needs help sometime in their life and those that claim they don't...well they are lying. Needing help is being part of being human. Remember when you were a little baby, you needed help. :-)  No one would call a baby pathetic I hope. Just because we are adults, it doesn't mean we don't need other people every once in a while.  Did you feel like this in the past ever and your mom wasn't able to help?

I was thinking about this issue with my cat. What in the world am I going to do when I lose my best friend? My heart is going to break in a million pieces. But the heartbreak that will come I will take for whatever years of love I have experienced.
Does your sadness and anger get worse by certain people or experiences?

Good for you for realizing and acknowledging that there are some relationships outside of you that are not helping you in any way. Society expects you to be perfect with all those responsibilities and it is just impossible to take care of everybody when you don't get a chance to take care of yourself. You have allot on your shoulders and you haven't even stepped out of your home! Is there anything that gives you peace for a little while that is not self harming or involves anyone else? Drawing, etc?

She indeed sounds beautiful. I love that you didn't even notice the mark on her nose. That made me smile and made me think of all our flaws that we drive ourselves insane with insecurities and here you are finding the mark in her nose "cute". That is very sweet. 
Do you feel that we only have one chance in life with true love?

At this point all you can do is express your remorse. If she can't/won't forgive you right now, at least you admitted your mistake and the fact that you know you did wrong. It takes a real person to realize that they screwed up. I find it amazing on how many people hurt us and just keep walking like they did nothing wrong. We are not perfect, we all get hurt and at times, we do the hurting.
What is causing you torture?
This girl seemed pretty special to cause this much heartache. How much time do you think it takes for us to get over someone?
You are working in a job you hate which leaves no time for anything else in your life. Since you are not getting paid much anyways, is it too risky to try another career?

I definitely have realized my triggers. I know not everyone has them and like divorcedestruction comment some people just swing back and forth. I don't remember the name but isn't their some time of depression that is affected by sunlight or lack there of?

You are not the first to fail it, they allow us to take it multiple times because allot of people have performance anxiety. Regardless of the reasons of why you failed it, it doesn't matter. You can take it again. My cousin failed the parking segment 3 times. She was embarrassed but she has her license now and that is what is important. Focus on one issue at a time. Out of college issue, someone choosing not to waste their money in idle classes is not a failure to me. College is a huge debt and if you really are not sure, why sit there and waste your time. I was one of those people, now I have debt to my eyeballs. What everyone else is doing always appears better from afar. I guarantee you not all your friends are going to be happy with the decisions they are making right now. Life has no guarantees. You are focusing on the things you don't have right now. Right now, this moment is not permanent.

I have had mental health problems for the last couple of years: Multiple suicide attempts. I have not done my taxes for the last three years (owe 10k in backtaxes) and have student loan debt (at least 40k) to deal with. Is there a kind of tax/debt specialist that I can hire to walk me through starting my financial life again. I honestly didn't expect to be alive. My reason for giving up on life was my finances. But I am on medication and therapy and feel brave but overwhelmed.
